claim_boundary: Internal benchmark maturity matrix only. It separates synthetic contracts, local/bootstrap evidence, and live missing evidence before any public comparison against Elastic, Wazuh, Appdome, Verimatrix, or Guardcore. It does not authorize vendor parity, production malware accuracy, or mobile shielding efficacy claims.

promotion_evidence.promotion_blocked_reason: The current 100-sample bootstrap slice cannot support a production false-positive rate without clean-corpus and telemetry evidence.

gates.claim_boundary: Local bootstrap goodware slice reports 0 FP on 100 samples; this is not a production false-positive rate.

promotion_evidence.promotion_blocked_reason: The current 100-sample local malware slice cannot support a governed false-negative rate without holdout and end-to-end alert evidence.

gates.claim_boundary: Local bootstrap malware slice reports 0 FN on 100 samples; governed malware detection quality is still unproven.
